positions.name: PallasineChecklistStanding
positions.frame: what is the institutional standing of the Pallasine checklist as the organization's onboarding standard?
positions.why: Both expressions concern the Pallasine checklist as a sanctioned organizational artifact: src-1 asserts its current mandatory scope (every new hire, first week, three components), while src-2 locates its authority in a recent supersession of the prior wiki page. The shared directional read is the checklist's institutional standing — one expression performing the mandate, the other recording the replacement that legitimized it. The conviction gradient (settled decision vs. retrospective claim) is appropriate tension within the frame: the mandate and its provenance are two faces of the same institutional fact.
